title: Spike: harness transcripts as the version source (Claude and Codex)
description:
Redesigned after design roast r1 (docs/superpowers/runs/2026-10-02-harness-version-evidence/2026-10-02-harness-version-evidence-roast-design-1.md (+ -step-back.md)). Confirm, for Claude and Codex (shared app-server daemon and --no-daemon), using a scratch Herdr pane and claude --settings / a temporary CODEX_HOME (never editing ~/.claude or ~/.codex): when the transcript at the payload's transcript_path first exists relative to SessionStart and tool events; where the version lives (Claude: per-entry 'version'; Codex: session_meta.cli_version) and how resume and fork affect it; that the recorded version is that of the process now writing (e.g. resume a session after an upgrade). acceptance_criteria: Note recorded with per-harness/config verdicts: transcript timing vs events, version field location, resume/fork behaviour, version-after-upgrade behaviour.

title: Integration sweep: harness version evidence end to end
description:
End to end with a stand-in harness: an unlisted new version -> no Health line -> first lifecycle + tool payloads -> working; a payload missing a required field -> degraded with the 'upgrade herdr-threads to X' action from a fake manifest; manifest known_broken for an unseen version -> broken with action; a version verified here stays working despite a manifest known_broken (doctor note only); offline / opt-out paths produce no fetch. Fix small gaps inline.

blocked-by ht-xoc.2: consumes all leaves (integration sweep)

Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-02-harness-version-evidence-design.md.
blocked-by ht-xoc.8: consumes all leaves (integration sweep)
Extra scenarios: a truncated/unparseable payload changes nothing and adds no Health line; a fixture harness-manifest branch file is fetched and a known_broken row for a never-verified version renders broken with its action, while a locally verified version stays working (doctor note) — all on an unchanged binary; an unattributable payload records nothing and doctor shows why.
Coverage r2 scenarios: the fixture harness-manifest file is generated by ht-xoc.6's writer, not by hand; a canary known_broken row for a version delivering only Malformed payloads leads to a broken line with action; harness_manifest=off → no fetch, embedded copy drives state; offline (unreachable URL) → cache/embedded fallback, no Health line, hook latency within budget; attributed version string equals the daemon-detected version for the stand-in harness.
acceptance_criteria: Each listed scenario is an integration test and passes; fmt + check + the new tests green.

title: Canary manifest writer and harness-manifest branch publishing
description:
Extend B6 canary: write rows to the harness-manifest branch by direct bot commit (contents: write for that branch only); only payload-contract failures write known_broken (with broken_event/broken_field); Tier 0, fingerprint drift, infra, inconclusive, flaky stay issue-only; baseline from the branch file (fallback in-repo); versions.py accepts schema 1 and 2; retention newest 50 per harness + known_broken + listed; fail above 80% of cap; contract_id from 'herdr-threads contract-id' at the tested commit; release workflow embeds the branch file. consumes: contract-id CLI, manifest schema 2. files: .github/workflows/harness-canary.yml, .github/workflows/release.yml, scripts/canary/*, scripts/harness-canary-selftest/*.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-02-harness-version-evidence-design.md.
blocked-by ht-xoc.1: consumes contract-id CLI
blocked-by ht-xoc.3: consumes manifest schema 2
Canary tests the current main contract and the latest release's contract and keeps one row per live contract.
supported_since: the canary also runs the latest release's contract (via that release's 'contract-id' and parser) against each new harness version and writes supported_since for the release whose contract passes. Manual edits: 'scripts/canary/manifest.py validate|set' validates schema 2 and writes rows with source=manual; the canary never overwrites a manual row. consumes: manifest schema 2 + branch path (ht-xoc.3), contract boundary (ht-xoc.1).
Rows' version keys are produced with 'herdr-threads harness-version normalize' (ht-xoc.1).
Roast r1 (design): the workflow's contents:write token is repo-wide; add (or document as prerequisite and check before pushing) a repository ruleset protecting main and v* tags.
acceptance_criteria: Offline selftest cases: all pass, payload break, known broken persists, flaky, Tier 0 failure -> issue only, retention and size-cap failure, schema-1 baseline upgrade; writer contract_id equals binary's. Writer keeps rows for both live contracts; a client-contract mismatch fixture. Manual row survives a canary run; validate rejects schema violations; supported_since filled from the passing release; release workflow test embeds the branch file. Writer normalizes versions through the binary's normalize command. Workflow checks the ruleset exists before pushing to harness-manifest.

title: Contract-first state derivation and Health/doctor rendering
description:
One pure function: local violation -> broken; ladder Refused -> broken; local verified -> working (manifest known_broken doctor-only); manifest known_broken (same contract) -> broken; manifest verified or listed -> working; else admitted -> new. Health: nothing for working/new; one degraded line for broken naming harness, version, event, field and action (upgrade herdr-threads to X / pin harness <= last working / issue URL). doctor: one line per harness incl. evidence source, effective fetch policy and cache time. Replaces B6's Optimistic Health note. consumes: ladder classification (B6), evidence rows, manifest model, contract_id. files: src/harness/state.rs (new), src/daemon/health.rs, src/cli/doctor.rs, docs/compatibility/harnesses.md, docs/operations.md.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-02-harness-version-evidence-design.md.
blocked-by ht-xoc.1: consumes contract_id
blocked-by ht-xoc.4: consumes evidence rows
blocked-by ht-xoc.3: consumes manifest model
Action selection (R4): 'upgrade herdr-threads to X' when the manifest has a verified row for this harness version under another contract_id with supported_since > the running release (X = that supported_since); else 'pin <harness> to <= Y' with Y = the newest version verified here (local evidence), else the manifest's last_working; else the row's issue_url, else the repo issues URL. Retire noise: inventory every existing version-related Health/doctor emitter (B6 Optimistic note, supported-range / unlisted warnings, harness limitation lines) and remove it or route it through this function. doctor renders the last_unattributed reason from ht-xoc.4. consumes: contract boundary (ht-xoc.1), evidence API (ht-xoc.4), manifest model (ht-xoc.3).
Coverage r2: ladder Refused maps to broken only for versions below the recipe floor (B6 'older than every recipe min') and known_broken; an unlisted or newer version is never Refused here. A version detected by the daemon's admission observer with no payload evidence and no manifest row triggers ensure_manifest (daemon side). Manual and canary rows derive identically. doctor prints each verdict's source (local evidence with event/field, canary row, manual row) and its issue_url. consumes: normalize_version (ht-xoc.1) for the detected version.
Roast r1 (design): state is computed per attributed version; Health shows the worst state among versions with a session in the last 24 h (last_seen_at); the PATH-detected version feeds doctor only before any attribution. Ladder Refused is split: below-floor → broken ahead of local verified (line: '<harness> <version> is below the supported floor <min>; upgrade <harness>'); recipe known_broken ranks below local verified (doctor-only when verified here), like manifest known_broken. Each broken source has its own line format.
acceptance_criteria: Table test over every input combination; Health shows no line for working/new; broken line carries the right action for each manifest situation; doctor output pinned. No Health line for an unlisted new version with B6's ladder code in place; each of the three action variants rendered; doctor shows the unattributed reason. An unlisted newer version with B6's ladder active is not Refused and adds no Health line; doctor shows the verdict source for each state. Roll-up: an old version with no session in 24 h drops out of Health; recipe known_broken + local verified → working with doctor note; below-floor line rendered.

title: Evidence store and verified-by-use recording
description:
Migration adding harness_version_evidence(harness, version, contract_id, lifecycle_ok_at, tool_ok_at, violation_at, violation_event, violation_field, last_seen_at); record lifecycle_ok on successful lifecycle check-in; hook sends best-effort non-blocking 'payload ok' note at most once per session while the daemon's reply says unverified; violations reported over B6's parse-failure channel; violation sticky until version or contract_id changes; record nothing when attribution is None. consumes: contract classifier, contract_id; attribution function. files: migrations/, src/store/, src/cli/hook.rs, src/service/dispatch.rs, src/protocol/.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-02-harness-version-evidence-design.md.
blocked-by ht-xoc.1: consumes contract classifier and contract_id
blocked-by ht-xoc.2: consumes attribution function
owns: harness_version_evidence schema and read API (verified = lifecycle_ok_at and tool_ok_at both set for the same harness, version, contract_id) and a per-harness last_unattributed(reason, at) record; consumed by ht-xoc.5. Calls ht-xoc.3's ensure_manifest on a first-seen version or a fresh violation.
blocked-by ht-xoc.3: consumes manifest fetch entry point (ensure_manifest)
ensure_manifest is called for every attributed payload whose version has no row, whatever its classification (Ok, Violation or Malformed), never awaited on the hook path.
Roast r1 (design): transport is a new capability-gated hook→daemon message HarnessEvidence{harness, attributed version, contract_id, event, outcome: ok|violation{field}|malformed}, sent for every admission tier, not gated on Optimistic or a Herdr pane; the daemon keys rows by the hook-sent contract_id (build skew safe); a daemon without the capability gets nothing. B6's parse-failure report is unchanged. files: + src/protocol/ (message + capability), src/service/dispatch.rs.
acceptance_criteria: Tests: verified after one lifecycle + one tool payload; hooks stop sending notes once verified; violation sticks; ambiguous attribution records nothing; migration applies on a populated store. Unattributable payload persists its reason and records no evidence row. A recording-path call with an unreachable manifest URL completes within the hook budget and still records evidence. Evidence sent for Listed/SchemaMatched/Optimistic alike; capability-absent daemon: hook skips silently.

title: Manifest: schema 2, embedded copy, cache and fetch policy
description:
Upgrade B6's in-repo harness-versions.json generator to schema_version 2 (canary-only fields null); embed at build (release: harness-manifest branch file, fallback in-repo); daemon cache in state dir with fetch time + ETag; fetch via 'curl -fsS --max-time 5' only on (a) version with no local evidence and no embedded/cached row or (b) a fresh violation, at most once/day/harness; 256 KB cap; unsupported schema_version -> no manifest; opt-out harness_manifest=off in instance settings or HERDR_THREADS_OFFLINE=1, read at each decision; missing curl = offline. owns: manifest model, loader, fetch policy. files: src/harness/manifest.rs (new), build.rs or include_str embed, src/daemon settings, docs/compatibility/harness-versions.json.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-02-harness-version-evidence-design.md.
Rows keyed by (harness, version, contract_id); the daemon uses only rows whose contract_id equals its own.
owns: manifest schema 2 row format (rows keyed by harness+version+contract_id; status, evidence, supported_since, last_working, issue_url, source canary|manual), the harness-manifest branch file path and raw URL, the schema_version rule, retention and size-cap invariants; consumed by ht-xoc.5 and ht-xoc.6. Fetch entry point: 'ensure_manifest(harness, reason)' called by the daemon from the recording path (first-seen version with no row, or a fresh violation); the state function (ht-xoc.5) only reads the cached/embedded manifest.
ensure_manifest contract (coverage r2): never blocks its caller — it schedules a detached fetch in the daemon and returns at once; fetch errors are logged (rate-limited) and otherwise silent. An unsupported schema_version from a fetch is treated as absent and never replaces a valid cache. Schema conformance test: files produced by ht-xoc.6's writer and by the in-repo generator both pass the reader.
Roast r1 (design): contract_id gates only status (verified/known_broken); release-pointer fields (latest_release, supported_since, last_working, issue_url) are read for (harness, version) from any row. Opt-out: JSON key "harness_manifest": "off"|"auto" in <instance>/settings.json (loaded at start, deny_unknown_fields — document that downgrading requires removing the key) or HERDR_THREADS_OFFLINE=1 in the daemon env; both take effect at daemon start.
acceptance_criteria: Fake-fetcher tests: triggers only on (a)/(b); once per day; opt-out and offline honored; cache then embedded fallback; size cap; schema mismatch -> no manifest; generator guard test updated for schema 2. A row with another contract_id is treated as no data. ensure_manifest returns in <10 ms with an unreachable URL; schema-3 fetch leaves the valid cache in place; writer-output conformance test. Mixed-contract rows: other contract's status ignored, its supported_since used; settings key parsed; doctor prints effective policy.

title: Seam contract: transcript version reader
description:
Attribution per spec (redesigned): read the running harness's version from the payload's transcript_path — Claude: 'version' of the newest JSONL entry (bounded tail read); Codex: cli_version of the newest session_meta record — in-process, ≤64 KB read, no exec, no process walk; result Attributed{harness, version} (version canonical via normalize_version) | Unattributable{reason} (absent, unreadable, no field). Inert by default: no caller changes behaviour here.
owns: transcript reader and its result type/reason strings; consumed by ht-xoc.4.
blocked-by ht-xoc.8: consumes transcript evidence note (timing, field location)
blocked-by ht-xoc.1: consumes normalize_version (canonical version string)
files: src/harness/attribution.rs (new), src/harness/mod.rs. Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-02-harness-version-evidence-design.md; roast: docs/superpowers/runs/2026-10-02-harness-version-evidence/2026-10-02-harness-version-evidence-roast-design-1.md (+ -step-back.md).
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests with Claude and Codex transcript fixtures: version extracted; resumed Codex rollout uses newest session_meta; a session whose transcript says A stays A after PATH moves to B; missing file / field → Unattributable with reason; read capped.

title: Payload contract declarations, contract_id and contract-id CLI
description:
Per-harness contract as data (event kinds consumed, required fields, JSON types) derived from the parsers in src/harness/claude.rs and codex.rs; contract_id = first 16 hex of SHA-256 over canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace); 'herdr-threads contract-id [--harness H] --json'; violation classifier (well-formed object, known event kind, required field missing/wrong type) vs malformed/unknown. owns: contract declaration, contract_id, violation classifier. files: src/harness/contract.rs (new), src/harness/claude.rs, src/harness/codex.rs, src/cli/commands.rs.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-02-harness-version-evidence-design.md.
owns: the contract boundary consumed by ht-xoc.4, .5, .6: contract_id = first 16 hex of SHA-256 over canonical JSON (sorted keys, no whitespace, fields sorted per event); stable across builds/toolchains; 'herdr-threads contract-id --json' prints {harness: contract_id} as the machine-readable form. Classifier result: Ok | Violation{event, field} | Malformed (unparseable/truncated JSON, unknown event kind) — Malformed never counts as a violation.
owns (coverage r2): canonical harness version string = bare semver core 'MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH' (strip prefixes/suffixes such as 'codex-cli ', ' (Claude Code)'), via normalize_version(harness, raw); exposed as 'herdr-threads contract-id --json' field 'normalize' examples and a 'herdr-threads harness-version normalize <harness> <raw>' subcommand so the canary uses the same function. Consumed by ht-xoc.2, .4, .5, .6.
Coverage/roast r1 (design): violations are classified against the event the hook was registered for (named on the hook command line), not the payload's own discriminator; a missing or renamed discriminator is a violation.
acceptance_criteria: Drift test fails if a parser requires an undeclared field; pinned contract_id test; classifier tests over existing payload fixtures (violation vs malformed vs unknown event). Classifier tests include a truncated stdin and unparseable JSON → Malformed. normalize_version table test for Claude and Codex raw forms. A payload with a renamed hook_event_name under a registered SessionStart hook is a Violation.

title: Harness version evidence: no noise on routine harness upgrades
description:
Implements docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-02-harness-version-evidence-design.md (branch harness-version-evidence). Verified-by-use harness versions, update check only on contract failure, runtime-fetched version manifest (harness-manifest branch), contract-first user-visible states (working / new / broken). Builds on B6 (ht-p03.13 ladder, ht-p03.23 Health honesty, ht-p03.14 canary): starts only after those are merged into main.
